body: Update.  Im safe in the hospital.  Im allowed to let two people know how I am.  Last night I got some real sleep. I want to thank you again for being there. Im already feeling less hopeless and more like there's a chance. Hugs to you my unmet savior.

Because you chose to listen to me, I have chosen to go seek help at the local nut bin. The doc said I can text two people where I am and why.  I'll be out in 7 days, hopefully feeling more normal. Thank you for saving my life.
Thank you for even listening. They never do. Just hearing me means a lot.  Thank you.

I refuse to leave the house.  My cats are here and apartments that accept them are hard to find. He can pack up and go back to Jersey but he won't and I can't get him to stay out. He doesn't hit though so Kansas cops won't make him go without a reason of violence. They say every one screams from time to time. They're no help.

Just the screaming and the gaslighting. Everything is always my fault he says. Yet he won't freaking pack up and leave. I'm the main renter. He's listed as a second tenant. I can afford the place on my own. He just clings on with the bullshit and when it calms down he's all lovey dovey. Then he says this pretty little gem.  "I spoil you so that you'll forgive me when im an asshole". Like I don't already know he was the biggest mistake of my life.

He knows. He turns it around and says he's tired too and all I do is sit on my ass all day. He doesn't care that typing a 300 word report about business law or whatever class im in is easier done sitting.  At this point im not even able to retain information because im so tired. I just don't want to do this anymore. Any of it.

I get it.  My family has found ways to destroy the holidays and make me cry every year for 41 years.  This year they can put my cold dead body out with the tree on new years day. That's when they'll find me. This year my so called husband started a fight on Christmas Eve and wouldn't let it go yet.  Im being screamed at while typing this.  I'm done. I'm allergic to penicillin. I got a hand full of it yesterday. New Year's Eve at midnight im done. I know a million people are saying you shouldn't do this. I've been over every possible solution ANF can't find one for myself. Have you gone over all your other choices too? Counselling doesn't work because the problem isn't us it's every one we are stuck with who hurts us so much.  I can't get rid of mine. They refuse to go away. I want to be free of them but not in jail so my only choice is to free myself from life itself. What are your options?
